topic: 公开滚动轴承振动数据的测量、校准、重复性、再现性与 measurement uncertainty / UQ
independence_statement: This is a new F04 search branch. Historical bearing results under evals/m1/results/ were not opened or copied.
research_brief_questions: Which public rolling-bearing vibration records expose enough acquisition metadata to reconstruct units, sensor provenance, and operating conditions?
Which calibration, repeatability, and reproducibility evidence is available for interpreting public bearing-vibration measurements?
Which uncertainty-aware or cross-dataset evaluations can expose measurement and domain-shift limits before a direction is confirmed?

discovery_sources.query: Which publicly released rolling bearing vibration datasets document sensor types, sampling rates, operating conditions, calibration provenance, or measurement traceability?
discovery_sources.promotion_rule: No result was admitted without an independent authoritative registry or official landing-page check.

discovery_sources.query: What peer-reviewed studies quantify repeatability, reproducibility, calibration, or measurement uncertainty in rolling-bearing vibration measurements?
discovery_sources.promotion_rule: No result was admitted without an independent authoritative registry or official landing-page check.

discovery_sources.query: Which papers evaluate public rolling-bearing vibration datasets for cross-dataset generalization, domain shift, condition metadata, and reproducibility limitations?
discovery_sources.promotion_rule: No result was admitted without an independent authoritative registry or official landing-page check.

queries: rolling bearing vibration measurement repeatability reproducibility DOI
rolling bearing vibration dataset public open access DOI
bearing fault diagnosis dataset reproducibility measurement variability DOI
vibration calibration measurement uncertainty accelerometer DOI
discovery_sources.promotion_rule: Search snippets and DOAJ/aggregator pages were used only to locate publisher or registry records.

tier_1: Crossref REST works records for journal and proceedings DOIs
DataCite REST DOI records for Zenodo, Mendeley Data, and Fordatis records
Publisher or official repository landing pages and open full-text records
cross_checks: PMC full text for the University of Ottawa data paper
NPL repository record for the vibration-calibration uncertainty paper
Zenodo and DataCite records for the Politecnico and Paderborn datasets
Fordatis/DataCite record for drive-train sensor metadata

raw_response_hash_bindings.normalization: Hash is over the raw response bytes returned by the Crossref or DataCite REST request; no JSON reserialization was used.

publisher_check_limitations: Several publisher pages returned anti-bot or access-denied responses to a non-browser HEAD probe; those records are labeled verified_registry when the current DOI registry record matched and the unavailable publisher check is preserved.
No model weights, datasets, papers, or full-text files were downloaded. Open web pages and public metadata were inspected only for bibliographic and evidence-level verification.
The public-data candidate pool is not a claim of exhaustiveness or novelty; it is bounded by the stated queries and source access on 2026-08-06.

The SciSpace result duplicated VBL-VA001 repository versions and surfaced preprints; the duplicate repository versions and preprint-only records were not admitted when a journal or single official dataset record was available.
excluded_evidence: Historical incomplete bearing Case B and all prior bearing results under evals/m1/results/
All tests, fixtures, fixture builders, replay artifacts, and paths under tests/
All M3 validators, composers, tests, fixtures, prompts, outputs, manifests, and paths under evals/m3/
Unverified search snippets, inferred identifiers, citation counts, and preprint-only support for the provisional main direction

read_path_attestation.attestation_scope: The list names every repository file opened by this upstream task; directory listings and git metadata were not counted as file opens.
